phase: Phase 3: Document Management & Live Storage Integration

tests.test_scenario: Validate default settings initialization and typed field loading
tests.expected_result: Settings initialize with valid ENV, port, and database URL
tests.actual_result: Settings initialized successfully with production database URL

tests.test_scenario: Validate LOG_LEVEL validation and case-insensitivity rejection
tests.expected_result: Valid levels uppercase normalized; invalid levels raise ValueError
tests.actual_result: Normalized 'DEBUG' and 'ERROR'; raised ValueError on 'INVALID_LEVEL'

tests.test_scenario: Validate root platform overview endpoint
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with application title, version 3.2.0, and operational status
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned with correct platform metadata payload

tests.test_scenario: Validate lightweight liveness endpoint /health/live without external dependencies
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with status=ok and UTC ISO timestamp
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned immediately without blocking on network services

tests.test_scenario: Validate readiness endpoint /health/ready independent of GPU availability
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with database latency and S3 health; GPU omitted from readiness contract
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 with healthy Neon DB ping and S3 bucket health; GPU not gating readiness

tests.test_scenario: Validate capabilities endpoint /health/capabilities reporting GPU VRAM & subsystems
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with PyTorch CUDA RTX 3050 hardware specs, DB stats, and storage stats
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 reporting NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU, CUDA 12.4, and uninitialized worker

tests.test_scenario: Validate Prometheus format exposition endpoint /metrics
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with text/plain exposition containing standard Prometheus metrics
tests.actual_result: Prometheus text exposition verified containing http_requests_total and process metrics

tests.test_scenario: Validate automatic X-Request-ID UUID generation when header is omitted
tests.expected_result: Response contains X-Request-ID header conforming to UUID4
tests.actual_result: UUID4 request ID generated and attached to response header

tests.test_scenario: Validate incoming client X-Request-ID header propagation through response and logs
tests.expected_result: Exact client request ID preserved and returned in response header
tests.actual_result: Propagated client-specified ID 'custom-request-id-12345' unchanged

tests.test_scenario: Validate domain AppError envelope formatting and code mapping
tests.expected_result: HTTP 400 with structured JSON error envelope: error, code, details, request_id, timestamp
tests.actual_result: Received HTTP 400 with VALIDATION_ERROR code and correlation ID

tests.test_scenario: Validate NotFoundError mapping to HTTP 404 with error envelope
tests.expected_result: HTTP 404 with RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND code and structured envelope
tests.actual_result: Received HTTP 404 with RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND code and details dictionary

tests.test_scenario: Validate unhandled internal exception shielding (no internal trace leak to client)
tests.expected_result: HTTP 500 with generic message and INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR code
tests.actual_result: Internal error masked with 'Internal server error' and correlation ID logged

tests.test_scenario: Validate connection pool reuse with zero state leakage across sequential checkouts
tests.expected_result: Single physical connection reused; app.* settings cleared completely between checkouts
tests.actual_result: Physical backend PID verified identical; all settings reset to empty string post-return

tests.test_scenario: Validate concurrent queries execute in strict tenant isolation without cross-talk
tests.expected_result: Concurrent tenant queries in asyncio gather execute concurrently without state interference
tests.actual_result: Concurrent sessions verified with isolated org IDs; zero cross-talk across connections

tests.test_scenario: Validate cross-organization row-level security isolation on documents table
tests.expected_result: Tenant A sees 1 document; Tenant B sees 0 documents despite record existing
tests.actual_result: Tenant A retrieved document; Tenant B returned exactly 0 records

tests.test_scenario: Validate cross-workspace row-level security isolation within same organization
tests.expected_result: User in Workspace 1 cannot access or view documents in Workspace 2
tests.actual_result: Cross-workspace query blocked by RLS policies; returned 0 rows

tests.test_scenario: Validate unprivileged database execution role ledgerone_app
tests.expected_result: Current database user is ledgerone_app; non-superuser verified
tests.actual_result: SET LOCAL ROLE ledgerone_app verified; rolsuper = false confirmed

tests.test_scenario: Validate fail-closed security when tenant context is omitted
tests.expected_result: Queries against documents, organizations, and workspaces return 0 rows
tests.actual_result: Returned exactly 0 rows across all tenant entities without tenant context

tests.test_scenario: Validate transaction-scoped setting lifecycle with automatic post-commit reversion
tests.expected_result: app.current_org_id setting active during transaction and reverted after commit
tests.actual_result: Setting active inside transaction; automatically reverted to empty string post-commit

tests.test_scenario: Validate transaction-scoped setting reversion upon transaction rollback
tests.expected_result: Simulated error triggers rollback and completely clears transaction-local settings
tests.actual_result: Setting reverted to empty string immediately after rollback exception

tests.test_scenario: Validate Argon2id password hashing and constant-time verification
tests.expected_result: Generates valid $argon2id$ hash with m=65536, t=3, p=4; correctly verifies valid and rejects invalid passwords
tests.actual_result: Argon2id format verified; verification succeeds for correct password and returns false for wrong password

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of empty passwords during hashing
tests.expected_result: Raises ValueError when empty password string is passed
tests.actual_result: ValueError correctly raised for empty password

tests.test_scenario: Validate legacy bcrypt verification fallback
tests.expected_result: Correctly verifies existing legacy $2b$ bcrypt hashes
tests.actual_result: Legacy bcrypt verified successfully; invalid password rejected

tests.test_scenario: Validate cryptographically secure opaque token generation and SHA-256 storage hashing
tests.expected_result: Generates URL-safe base64 tokens with 256-bit entropy; produces 64-character hex SHA-256 hash
tests.actual_result: Length > 40 URL-safe string generated; deterministic 64-char hex SHA-256 hash verified

tests.test_scenario: Validate JWT access token encoding and claims validation
tests.expected_result: Encodes sub, email, org_id, role, is_platform_admin, jti, exp, iat; decodes accurately
tests.actual_result: All claims decoded cleanly with valid exp and jti

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of expired JWT access tokens
tests.expected_result: Raises AuthenticationError when token exp has passed
tests.actual_result: AuthenticationError raised with 'Token has expired'

tests.test_scenario: Validate cryptographic signature tampering rejection
tests.expected_result: Raises AuthenticationError when signature bytes are modified
tests.actual_result: AuthenticationError raised with 'Invalid token signature or payload'

tests.test_scenario: Validate user registration, login, /auth/me, refresh token rotation, and reuse detection revocation
tests.expected_result: Complete auth lifecycle: registration (201), login (200), me (200), refresh token rotation (200), reuse of old token revokes family (401)
tests.actual_result: All endpoints validated; token reuse triggered immediate family revocation and rejected both tokens
tests.environment: Neon PostgreSQL 18.6 AWS Singapore / FastAPI ASGI / Python 3.11.9

tests.test_scenario: Validate user logout and refresh token revocation
tests.expected_result: HTTP 200 with message 'Logged out successfully'; subsequent refresh with revoked token rejected (401)
tests.actual_result: Logout succeeded; subsequent refresh attempt blocked with 401 Unauthorized
tests.environment: Neon PostgreSQL 18.6 AWS Singapore / FastAPI ASGI / Python 3.11.9

tests.test_scenario: Validate multi-tenant organization creation, workspace provisioning, and granular RBAC role assignment
tests.expected_result: Org admin creates org and workspace; non-member blocked (403); member invited; reviewer assigned to workspace; workspace permissions enforced
tests.actual_result: Full hierarchy validated; RLS tenant isolation verified across organizations and workspaces
tests.environment: Neon PostgreSQL 18.6 AWS Singapore / FastAPI ASGI / Python 3.11.9

tests.test_scenario: Validate magic number / file signature inspection across PDF, PNG, JPEG, CSV, TXT
tests.expected_result: Accurately detects mime type from magic bytes regardless of file extension
tests.actual_result: Detected application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg, text/csv, text/plain

tests.test_scenario: Validate PDF page count and structure inspection using PyPDFium2
tests.expected_result: Returns application/pdf, 64-char sha256, page_count=1, valid file size
tests.actual_result: Extracted page_count=1 and accurate file size via pypdfium2

tests.test_scenario: Validate raster image dimensions and format inspection using PIL
tests.expected_result: Returns image/png with width=10, height=10, format=PNG
tests.actual_result: Extracted width=10, height=10, and frame count via Pillow

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of empty file uploads
tests.expected_result: Raises ValidationError with 'File content is empty'
tests.actual_result: ValidationError raised with message 'File content is empty'

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of oversized files exceeding 50 MB boundary
tests.expected_result: Raises ValidationError when size exceeds configured max limit
tests.actual_result: ValidationError raised with 'exceeds maximum limit'

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of corrupt or truncated PDF binary payloads
tests.expected_result: Raises ValidationError with 'Corrupt or invalid PDF file structure'
tests.actual_result: Corrupt PDF stream rejected safely without process crash

tests.test_scenario: Validate rejection of unsupported binary payloads (executables, raw data)
tests.expected_result: Raises ValidationError with 'Unsupported file format'
tests.actual_result: Unsupported octet-stream payload rejected

tests.test_scenario: Validate deterministic SHA-256 calculation for deduplication
tests.expected_result: Generates consistent 64-character lowercase hexadecimal hash
tests.actual_result: Deterministic 64-character hex hash verified

tests.test_scenario: Validate complete document lifecycle: direct upload, presigned upload intent & lease, duplicate detection in workspace, background job queue creation, listing, preview URL, RBAC enforcement, soft delete and restore
tests.expected_result: Direct upload (201), extraction job queued, duplicate rejected (409), presigned intent (201), complete-upload (200), viewer upload blocked (403), viewer read allowed (200), soft delete hides doc, restore unhides doc
tests.actual_result: Full document lifecycle and RBAC verified on live Neon PostgreSQL with 100% assertions satisfied
tests.environment: Neon PostgreSQL 18.6 AWS Singapore / FastAPI ASGI / Python 3.11.9

tests.test_scenario: Validate live S3 upload, download, and SHA-256 byte integrity against Neon S3 bucket assets
tests.expected_result: Direct upload to Neon S3 succeeds, object_exists=True, downloaded bytes match exactly, SHA-256 verified, delete removes object
tests.actual_result: Live upload, head_object, download, and deletion verified on Neon S3 ap-southeast-1

tests.test_scenario: Validate presigned PUT upload and GET download URL generation with lease TTLs
tests.expected_result: Presigned URLs generated containing valid HTTP endpoint, SigV4 headers or path
tests.actual_result: Presigned PUT and GET URLs successfully generated with 900s and 3600s TTLs

tests.test_scenario: Validate upload lease validation and expiration rejection
tests.expected_result: Attempting to complete an upload after 15-minute lease expiration raises ConflictError (409)
tests.actual_result: ConflictError raised with 'Upload lease has expired. Please re-initiate upload intent.'

tests.test_scenario: Validate database transactional atomicity: rollback clears inserted document record
tests.expected_result: Simulated error inside transaction rolls back uncommitted document, leaving 0 records
tests.actual_result: Document ID not found in database post-rollback; zero orphan records verified

tests.test_scenario: Validate cross-workspace document access denial within same organization
tests.expected_result: User in Workspace B receives 403 Forbidden attempting to access Workspace A documents
tests.actual_result: Workspace B user blocked with HTTP 403; Workspace B listing contains 0 Workspace A documents
tests.environment: Neon PostgreSQL 18.6 AWS Singapore / FastAPI ASGI / Python 3.11.9

tests.test_scenario: Validate safe ZIP-based Office OpenXML decompression limits (ZIP bomb defense, path traversal, manifest inspection)
tests.expected_result: Valid DOCX passes; path traversal (../../etc/passwd), corrupt zip, and missing manifest rejected with ValidationError
tests.actual_result: Valid DOCX verified; dangerous zip entries and corrupt packages rejected safely
